name: Browser Use
shortDescription: Open-source Python agent that controls a browser. We imported the package locally; no model call.
longDescription: Browser Use is a Python agent for driving a browser. We installed browser-use and imported Agent. We did not sign up, pay, or call a model. Docs mention separately billed cloud browsers; local use still needs your own browser and model keys.
pricingNotes: Cloud stealth browsers billed separately per docs/marketing.
freeTierNotes: Pay as you go after a free start. No monthly subscription.
bestFor: Agents that need to open pages, click, and type
Python projects that can bring their own browser and model
notIdealFor: Jobs that only need an HTTP search API
A no-code hosted agent with no local setup
strength: We imported browser-use 0.13.11, which is built for agents that open pages, click, and type.
weakness: You bring your own browser and model, and the docs bill cloud stealth browsers separately from the library.
smokeTestNotes: Install/import only; no API key, no LLM invoke, no signup.

handsOn.detail: pip install + import browser_use; from browser_use import Agent
